notes.title: Challenging Missions & Game Economy Update
notes.content:
This update brings you a whole new interactive tutorial that leads you through the gameplay. There are 40 new missions to play strategically along with pro-tips to guide you to take correct decisions in the game. 

The UI has been worked upon to make it more user-friendly. There is a new feature introduced which helps you when you fall short of finances. It allows you to declare bankruptcy and the game helps you with money which lets you continue the game.  

The gameplay economy has been completely re-balanced. The research centre now allows various up-gradation features which help to play the game better way. 

This build is tested multiple times and is more stable.

[b]This update includes[/b]:
- Interactive tutorial
- 40 new missions
- Pro tips added
- Updated UI
- Claim Bankruptcy if finances fall to 0
- New game economy
- Multiple up-gradation via Research centre
- More stable build!

notes.title: Environment Upgrade
notes.content:
Today's upgrades include a wide range of changes. New colors are added to the game as the buildings are completely renewed and the animation done makes it more real; the player can see what is going around in his area and each movement is noted. 
The list of new missions allows the user to proceed ahead in the game in a balanced manner and the strategy the player has to plan has to be carefully thought of and executed. 


Update Details:

- Upgraded buildings
- New animations
- New missions
- Better strategical play
- Bug free 
- New and exciting graphics!

notes.title: Bug Free and Much Faster!
notes.content:
Happy New Year, Player!

We heard everything you say, in any in-game supported language and that's why we just released a very important update for nStations and you must install it as soon as possible.

nStations version 1.1
[list][*]All reported bugs were fixed
[*]Language choice is now open when you run the game for the first time (it's the first drop-down box you'll see in the screen)
[*]Unity3D configuration screen at start allows to choose Screen resolution and Graphics qualities
[*]Much better performance
[*]Use the WASD keys to move the camera
[/list]

Remember!!!
We offer support on our Discord Server (https://discordapp.com/invite/dnK8wFe) and by email (oxeliz@oxeliz.com) in EVERY SINGLE LANGUAGE supported in the game. So if you have any doubts or problems to report, we'll answer you as soon as possible, as we always did.

Last but not least, thank you so much for playing our game and for contributing to its growth.
